text:
Devon: spotted repeated tail spikes on APAC rack-18 starting 09:12 UTC. GPU-3 thermal events + nvlink retries. Impact: 2 dedicated pools + ~12 shared tenants.
Maya: Link the alert and heatmap pls.
Devon: https://telemetry.redwood/local/heatmap/rack-18 - logs show nvlink_drop and temp >90C. Example: ```2026-03-23T09:12:23Z WARN gpu[3] temp=91.8C nvlink_drop=9 p99=1.7s```
ops-bot: Automated mitigation kicked: soft-evac -> pool:soft-reserve-59 for tenants with repeated tail breaches.
Alex: Can we formalize a multi-step isolation play? Idea: 1) soft-reserve fractional slice (short TTL); 2) prefer quantized/low-mem variants; 3) manual dedicate after churn. Call it "isolation ladder".
Priya: Need cost guardrails. Fractional slices for many tenants could push committed spend up. We should fallback to quantized models first when available. Redwood-Optimize can recommend binning.
Jamie: Ops plan: start a 5% canary redirecting worst offenders to soft-reserve + quantized models. Track quality on canary prompt set. If quality loss <1% and latency improves, expand.
Maya: Give prometheus snippets for the canary dashboard.
Alex: Queries: ```sum(rate(requests_total{region="apac", model!~"quant.*"}[1m])) by (tenant),
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, tenant)),
sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[1m])) by (tenant)```
Devon: I'll add those to Grafana and start canary at 09:40 UTC. Also enabling thermal-proactive-drain on the host.
Priya: Add a cycle-detection backoff: if tenant flips >3 times in 15m, mark for manual review and pin to dedicated for 24h to avoid oscillation.
Alex: Allocator needs region-tunable knobs. Suggest config block: `isolation_ladder: {p99_ms: 500, eviction_per_s: 20, duration_min: 3, churn_limit: 3}`
allocator-bot: Created pool fractional-isolate-canary-442. Applied routing for tenants [t-112, t-409, t-777].
Jamie: I'll sync with Product for a short customer-facing note about minor Dedicated reshuffles.
Maya: Also capture this sequence in the incident log for later postmortem. Ping me if we expand.
Devon: Canaried at 09:40. First telemetry in ~10m.
ops-bot: Canary dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/isolations/canary-442
Devon: 10m update: canary tenants p99 dropped from ~1.7s -> ~430ms, kvcache evictions down ~60%. Expanding to 15%.
Priya: Good signal. I'm running a quick cost sim for hourly vs monthly committed impact if slices persist. Will report in 30m.
Alex: If sustained improvement >30% with <1% quality loss, recommend region-wide soft-reserve policy plus finance alerting.
Jamie: Action items: 1) implement isolation ladder config; 2) add allocator region flags; 3) cost sim from Priya; 4) product comms draft; 5) postmortem entry.
Devon: Leaving canary running and collecting traces. Will update thread with final numbers.
allocator-bot: Expanded canary -> 15% traffic. Monitoring thresholds active.
Devon: FYI thermal on gpu-3 trending down after drains. If host temp doesn't fall in 20m we'll trigger manual migrate.
Maya: Thanks. Keep autoscale/thermal-drain enabled and hold off hard carveouts until postmortem. :thumbsup:
